name: Product Category
author: Kushang Tailor

sections.description:
Product Category helps you display WooCommerce product categories in a clean, customizable, and conversion-friendly way. Instead of sending visitors through a plain category list, you can build stylish category sections that guide shoppers toward the products they want faster.

Use it on landing pages, shop pages, homepages, blog posts, sidebars, and custom layouts. Whether you prefer the Block Editor, Elementor, SiteOrigin, or a simple shortcode, Product Category gives you a practical way to showcase selected categories with layout, typography, image, color, and pagination controls.

The plugin is built for store owners, designers, and developers who want more control over how WooCommerce categories appear without writing custom templates.

Compatible with:

  • Shortcode for classic pages, posts, and custom content areas.
  • Block Editor with a dedicated Gutenberg product category block.
  • SiteOrigin Editor with a product category widget.
  • Elementor with a product category widget.

The main strength of this plugin is its editor flexibility: choose your preferred workflow, select the categories you want to highlight, and adjust the display to match your store design.

Features

  • Add a custom title above your product category listing.
  • Select specific WooCommerce product categories to display.
  • Choose from available category layout and style options.
  • Control the number of categories shown per row and per section.
  • Set category ordering by name or slug.
  • Display categories in ascending or descending order.
  • Show or hide product category descriptions.
  • Enable or disable pagination for longer category lists.
  • Show or hide category thumbnail images.
  • Add image alt text support for better accessibility and SEO.
  • Customize typography, including font size, font weight, font family, and letter spacing.
  • Adjust colors and visual styles to match your WooCommerce store.
  • Use the dedicated Elementor widget for live page-builder editing.
  • Use the Gutenberg block to build category sections directly inside the Block Editor.
  • Use shortcodes when you need a simple, editor-independent embed option.

Live Editing with Elementor and Block Editor

Product Category supports live editing through its own Elementor widget and Gutenberg block. You can select categories, adjust display settings, refine styles, and preview changes while you build the page.
sections.installation:
Two Way to install

First Way – Via FTP.

1. Download plugin file and unzip it.
2. In the extracted folder you will find product-category.zip file. Extract it.
3. Upload product-category folder into Plugins folder in your WordPress installation (/wp-content/plugins) using an FTP client.
4. Log into your WordPress admin panel and click on the Plugins tab.
5. Find installed plugin from the list and click Activate button.

Second Way – Via WordPress Dashboard.

1. Log into your WordPress admin panel and click on the Plugins tab.
2. Navigate to Add New > Upload
3. Click Choose File and select product-category.zip file on your computer.
4. Then hit Install Now and the plugin will be uploaded and installed.
5. Than click Activate button.
